title: A store hiccup the reader recovers from never fails a subtitle, font or chapter-picture job
description: Serves "Any film plays, and plays well.". Seen: BL-169, a cut the reader healed still failed a job or skipped a chapter. (The job-queue refactor moves to the backlog.)
acceptanceCriteria: Every job kind observes a store failure only where store.Reader gives up (store.InputWithFailure, JS-088): the chapter-picture, subtitle, fonts and .sup jobs no longer wrap the store below the Reader, so a cut the Reader healed never fails a job or skips a chapter (BL-169)
Every existing test of those job kinds passes
notes: Extended from the Fable 5.2 blind audit, 2026-11-14.
